Also, prices aren't set by the inherent properties of an item, they're set by supply and demand. Gold-plated armour is extremely heavy on the supply side of that, so it doesn't run for as much.

I think gold plated armour's a good thing for a newish player, especially if they have a friend who can make it. Stuff's dirt cheap really.

comments.author: Liza
comments.body:
Yet another dumbass that doesn't realize (or probably even care) that refining boots fails, a lot. This armour does not fail, it isn't one you can refine, short of high alchemy (and that fails a lot, too).

Armour: put your mats in click produce.

Boots: put your mats in, click to improve, click to improve, ... fail, bye bye mats and boots. Start over.

Yes, there are tactics to mitigate losses a bit, but it's still not comparable. Every time you improve a boot by a few defense points you risk losing it, and you have to plan to use a whole lot more mats than the initial production cost to get anywhere with boot making.

Junchul, you're a damned fool.
